answer: A lotus-grove layered bond stops fake identities. Each agent locks 70, earns a grove receipt, then a quartz seal; one failed layer burns the whole lotus. The receipt costs 30 first and 30+5(k-1) for the k-th, as keeper checks queue up. 1,000 fakes pay 2,527,500 for receipts, 70,000 locked, 25,000 in quartz seals, vs a 40,000 pool. A forgery ring reusing one receipt loses every layer. Honest agents pay 30 once and keep the bond.
